lecons.title: Food and its six classes
lecons.summary: Food is any substance that living things eat or drink, or that plants absorb, to maintain life and growth. There are six classes: carbohydrates, proteins, vitamins, fats and oils, mineral salts and water. Each class has its own sources and its own work in the body.

lecons.title: Cooking methods

lecons.title: Food conservation
lecons.summary: Food conservation is the process of keeping food to prevent it from getting bad. Food can be dried in the sun, frozen in the cold, canned in tins, salted, or smoked over a fire. Each method stops what makes food spoil: water, warmth, or air.

lecons.title: Kitchen utensils and household furniture
lecons.summary: Kitchen utensils are hand held tools used in the kitchen for preparing food: the mortar and pestle, the pot, the knife, the spoon. Household furniture are the things of the home you can move and arrange to make the home more comfortable: chairs, tables, beds, cupboards. One prepares, the other makes the home easy to live in.
